title: Reflection nebula around HD 87643
caption: Reflection nebula around the star HD 87643, imaged by the MPG/ESO 2.2-metre telescope

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: An extended nebula of gas and dust surrounds the star HD 87643 at the centre of this image, reflecting the star's light back towards us. Bright, ragged tendrils of gas and dust stretch through it.

HD 87643 is a B[e] star, an unusual type of hot star surrounded by gas and dust. The wind flowing from the central star appears to have shaped the nebula, sweeping it into the tattered tendrils seen here.

Looking closely at those features has given astronomers a clue to the star's behaviour. A careful study of them seems to show that the star throws off matter at regular intervals, every 15 to 50 years. Those repeated episodes are written into the structure of the nebula around it. ESO's MPG/ESO 2.2-metre telescope at La Silla captured the image with its Wide Field Imager, combining data taken through three filters: B, V and R.

understand.summary: This visible-light image was made with the Wide Field Imager on the MPG/ESO 2.2-metre telescope through B, V and R filters. The colour assigned to each filter is not published.
understand.eye: The long exposures gather far more light than the eye, bringing out the faint reflected glow of the nebula.
